description: qou-pdix route 5 / qou-cds1 branch 3. Im(q) is NOT the source of the elliptic generator route 5 needs. A purely elliptic Kohno-Drinfeld generator needs |q| = 1, impossible since Re q = 1.10998 > 1 forces |q| > 1 for every Im q. Allowing a complex character and keeping its real part needs Im q = +-0.139956 (12.61 % of Re q) and leaves Im[character] = 0.014069 -- 8.40x the deviation being explained and 18074 sigma -- which must vanish since Q_beta is real, and vanishes only at Im q = 0. The non-Hermitian route gives ellipticity but forces unit-modulus braiding eigenvalues, which cannot match the Hecke pair {1.10998, -0.90092}, dissolving the scale-fixing. Does NOT refute conj:im-q-physical-role (its chirality role is untouched). Also quantifies 'retire the tower': the residual after 1 - theta^2/2 is -7.3394e-5 = 94.3 sigma (real, not droppable), c_2 = -1 consumes 98.84 % of it, and c_3 plus every coefficient above rests on a 1.09-sigma leftover (absolute bar sigma/u^3 = 1.2598, reproducing Step 15's 1.2619). And c_3's CENTRAL VALUE shifts 33.49 % -- -2.069343 via cos, -1.376381 via the parabola -- on a choice the data resolves at 0.549 sigma. Lean: QOU/QBeta/ImQCannotSupplyEllipticGenerator.lean, 4 theorems, sorry-free.

assertions.name: purely_elliptic_generator_impossible_for_any_im_q
assertions.detail: Re q = 1.109978583 > 1 forces |q|^2 >= 1.232052454 > 1 for every Im q, so ln q is never purely imaginary (Lean abs_sq_gt_one)

assertions.name: forcing_the_real_part_needs_a_large_im_q
assertions.detail: Im q = +-0.1399557732 = 12.609 % of Re q, and the bare threshold for Re[character] < 1 is already 11.065 % — not a perturbation

assertions.name: complex_character_leaves_an_imaginary_part_dwarfing_the_effect
assertions.detail: Im[character] = 0.014068933 is 8.4006x the deviation and 18073.9 sigma; real part verified against the closed form to 1e-30

assertions.name: hecke_pair_has_no_unit_modulus_member
assertions.detail: {q, -1/q} moduli are 1.109978583 and 0.900918284; an elliptic generator forces unit modulus, so route B dissolves the Kohno-Drinfeld scale-fixing (Lean hecke_eigenvalues_not_unit_modulus)

assertions.name: the_residual_is_real_and_large
assertions.detail: delta = -7.3393707e-5 = 94.2863 sigma — retiring the tower does NOT mean dropping the correction

assertions.name: c2_consumes_almost_all_of_the_residual
assertions.detail: -u^2 = -7.2543284e-5 is 98.841 % of delta, which is why c_2 = -1 looks good (and is 1.6 sigma consistent, Step 15)

assertions.name: c3_and_above_rest_on_a_one_sigma_residue
assertions.detail: what is left for c_3 and every coefficient above is -8.5042228e-7 = 1.093 sigma; the absolute bar sigma/u^3 = 1.25984 reproduces Step 15's independently-propagated 1.2619

assertions.name: c3_central_value_is_parametrisation_dependent
assertions.detail: c_3 = -2.0693426 via cos, -1.3763814 via 1 - theta^2/2 — a 33.49 % shift from a choice the data resolves at 0.549 sigma. c_3 is not merely imprecise; its central value is an artefact of the parametrisation

context.axis: qou-cds1 branch 3: is Im(q) the elliptic source? and what is 'no tower'?
context.answer: Im(q) is not the source. Purely elliptic needs |q| = 1, impossible at Re q > 1; the complex-character workaround needs Im q = 12.61 % of Re q and leaves an imaginary part 8.40x the effect, which must vanish and does so only for real q. The non-Hermitian route dissolves the Kohno-Drinfeld scale-fixing. 'No tower' means keeping delta = -7.3394e-5 as one measured number rather than a series: c_2 = -1 consumes 98.84 % of it and c_3 and above rest on 1.09 sigma.
context.does_not_refute: conj:im-q-physical-role. Its chirality role is untouched and Im(q) may be physical for other reasons; what is settled is that it cannot supply the elliptic generator.
context.scope: Scope-(b) for the exclusions, scope-(a) for the tower measurement. Nothing derived, proposed, wired or readmitted; no convention adjudicated.
